rows.grounds: numeral indicating the count of womb-diagrams
past participle describing the afflicted beings

items.question: How many womb-diagrams are said to torment beings in this enumeration?
premises: Beings are tormented within those womb-diagrams.
items.inference: Torment is said to occur across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact scope of yoniyantreṣu is not further specified.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
